articles.title: First Look at "Ink"
articles.description: https://instagram.com/p/Dcdv-7HAKwm Netflix has shared the first stills from Ink , the latest film from Oscar-winning director Danny Boyle. As TIFF's website puts it, Ink "charts the meteoric rise of Rupert Murdoch (Guy Pearce) and his fledgling but instantly notorious newspaper The Sun, as he and editor Larry Lamb (Jack O’Connell) create the blueprint for UK tabloid culture." Claire Foy also stars. Ink will open Venice Film Festival next week. In the US and Latin America, it will debut in select theatres December 11 before arriving on Netflix January 8. 1 & 2

articles.title: 88 People So Dumb You Can’t Help But Wonder How They Even Survive
articles.description: Look, we’ve all made our fair share of whoopsies along the way. Sometimes it’s absentmindedness, a brain fart, or one of those moments when your brain just seems to clock out. Other times, though, a mistake is so spectacularly dumb that even you can’t fathom how you got there. We’ve rounded up some of the most hilariously cringeworthy examples of people saying or doing things so impossibly dumb that you have to wonder if even a single brain cell was involved. Some showed self-awareness after the fact; others doubled down. Either way, the results are comedy gold.
